citations.verbatim_statement: For fixed \(k,d_x,d_z\), Assumption 4 requires finite \(L_X,L_{ZX},L_{ZXY}>0\) with \(\lVert X\rVert_2\le L_X\), \(\lVert ZX^\top\rVert_2\le L_{ZX}\), and \(\lVert YZX^\top\rVert_2\le L_{ZXY}\) almost surely; it requires \(\pi:=\min_{t\in\{0,1\}}\Pr(T=t)>0\) and, for the population right singular basis \(V_k\) of \(M_{\mathrm{stack}}\), \(\sigma:=\min\{\sigma_k(M_{\mathrm{stack}}),\min_{t\in\{0,1\}}\sigma_k(M_{ZX\mid t}V_k)\}>0\).  The displayed \(M_X,M_Y,\kappa_B,\Gamma_X,\Gamma_Y\), and \(\kappa_{ZX}^{\star}\) are then defined as fixed population conditioning quantities.  Assumption 3 requires \(\tau(u)\ne\tau(v)\) for every \(u\ne v\).  Theorem 7.2 assumes Assumption 2, strict latent positivity, Assumption 4, and spectral separation, takes the latter as vacuous when \(k=1\), imposes its displayed \(n,\eta\)-dependent radius conditions, and concludes simultaneous finite-sample bounds for the effects, anchor-normalized feature matrix, and simplex-projected mixture proportions.

env.world: A one-unit full-data PROBABILITY law \(P\) for \((U,T,X,Z,Y(0),Y(1),Y)\) on the Borel product space \(\{1,\dots,k\}\times\{0,1\}\times\mathbb R^{d_x}\times\mathbb R^{d_z}\times\mathbb R^3\), with fixed known latent cardinality \(k\ge 2\) and fixed proxy dimensions \(d_x,d_z\ge k\).  The latent-class masses are \(p_u:=P(U=u)\), the latent conditional potential-outcome means are \(\mu_{tu}:=E_P[Y(t)\mid U=u]\) with latent-class effects \(\tau_u:=\mu_{1u}-\mu_{0u}\) (common value \(\tau_\star\) under homogeneity), the proxy feature matrices are \(A_t(:,u):=E_P[Z\mid U=u,T=t]\in\mathbb R^{d_z\times k}\) and \(B(:,u):=E_P[X\mid U=u]\in\mathbb R^{d_x\times k}\), and \(e_1\) is the first canonical basis vector of \(\mathbb R^{d_x}\).  The observed record is \(O=(T,X,Z,Y)\), and the observed margin \(P_O\) is the marginalization of \(P\) along \(w\mapsto O\), i.e. the pushforward \(P\circ O^{-1}\), which is again a probability law.  The uniformly conditioned causal VMW submodel \(\mathcal M\) is the set of such \(P\) satisfying the ten member conditions of \(\mathrm{def:model\text{-}class}\) at the fixed margins \(L\ge1\), \(\pi_0\in(0,1/(2k)]\), \(\sigma_0\in(0,1]\), with derived effect-support radius \(L_\tau:=4L\sqrt{d_z}/\sigma_0\); \(\mathcal M(g)\) is its gap-localized stratum at nearest-effect gap \(\delta(P)\) of order \(g\in(0,1/4]\).

env.world: The observed i.i.d. proxy experiment: \(O_1,\dots,O_n\) are independent with common observed law \(P_O\), the probability law obtained by marginalizing the full-data law \(P\) onto the observed coordinates, so the observed sample law is the probability law \(Q_P^{(n)}:=P_O^{\otimes n}\) and \(\mathcal E_n:=\{Q_P^{(n)}:P\in\mathcal M\}\).  Armwise counts are \(N_{t,n}:=\sum_i\mathbf 1\{T_i=t\}\); the total Borel empirical summary \(\widehat S_n:=(\widehat M_{0,n},\widehat M_{1,n},\widehat N_{0,n},\widehat N_{1,n},\widehat m_{X,n})\) divides by \(\max\{1,N_{t,n}\}\) and is the zero matrix on an empty arm.  Inference runs at miscoverage \(\alpha\in(0,1/2)\) or generic tail level \(\eta\in(0,1/2)\), through the simultaneous radius \(r_{n,\alpha}:=C_0L\sqrt{\log(C_0/\alpha)/n}\) and the concentration event \(E_P:=\{d_S(\widehat S_n,S(P))\le r_{n,\alpha}\}\), with \(C_0\) depending only on \(k,d_x,d_z,\pi_0,\sigma_0\).

env.world: The observable moment-summary space: \(M_t(P):=E_{P_O}[ZX^\top\mid T=t]\), \(N_t(P):=E_{P_O}[ZX^\top Y\mid T=t]\), \(m_X(P):=E_{P_O}[X]\), collected into \(S(P):=(M_0,M_1,N_0,N_1,m_X)\in(\mathbb R^{d_z\times d_x})^4\times\mathbb R^{d_x}\), metrised by \(d_S(s,s'):=\sum_{j=1}^4\lVert s_j-s'_j\rVert_{\mathrm{op}}+\lVert s_5-s'_5\rVert_2\).
